Davenport And Commerce Llc accumulated 0.05% or 82,733 shares.
Dnb Asset Management As increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 177.6% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dnb Asset Management As bought 2.63M shares as the company’s stock rose 5.35% with the market. The institutional investor held 4.10 million shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $198.43M, up from 1.48 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dnb Asset Management As who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $216.79 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.10% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $52.37. About 14.16M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 14.08% since March 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.62% the S&P500.
Dnb Asset Management As, which manages about $7.52 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 156,957 shares to 1.01 million shares, valued at $155.75 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Gilead Sciences Inc (NASDAQ:GILD) by 115,900 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 134,482 shares, and cut its stake in Medtronic Inc.
